paid_layer_limits.comment: paid-01 (POLAR-PAYWALL-PLAN §D). A manifest that ADDS or CHANGES a `paid` block counts against this lower ceiling: paid listings invoke gateway trust surfaces (private-repo access via the okfhub GitHub App, license-gated reads), so they ramp slower than free listings. Requires an established identity — a namespace must already have at least one merged (free) publish before its first paid PR passes.
